name: State of Leonida
subtitle: The whole map
summary: Rockstar's take on Florida: a full state rather than a single city, stretching from the neon of Vice City through swamps, sugar country, mountains and a faded Gulf-coast beach town.

facts.text: GTA VI is set across the state of Leonida, with Vice City as its centrepiece.
Rockstar's site groups the state into named regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park and Port Gellhorn.
The playable map is reported to be about three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2's.
Rockstar has described it as the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series so far.

name: Vice City
subtitle: The main city
summary: The Miami-inspired heart of Leonida, where sunshine, celebrity and excess run together and everyone is chasing something. Home turf for Boobie Ike's empire and the place the story keeps returning to.

facts.text: The centrepiece of the map, returning for the first time since 2002's Vice City — now set in the present day.
Rockstar sums the city up as sunshine, celebrity and hedonism, a place where everyone wants a piece of the action.
Ocean Beach — the Vintage Vice City Pack's garage sits nearby — and the Bayside area were both shown in official material.
A Wynwood-style arts district called Stockyard has been reported.

name: Leonida Keys
subtitle: Island chain
summary: A laid-back string of islands with a long smuggling tradition. Jason's home, and Brian Heder's turf.

facts.text: Modelled on the Florida Keys; where Jason lives and works for local drug runners.
Brian Heder ran product here in the 1980s and still does.

name: Grassrivers
subtitle: Wetlands
summary: Leonida's Everglades: sawgrass, airboats, alligators and places nobody goes looking.

facts.text: A vast wetland region inspired by the Everglades.
Airboat rides through the swamp featured in the Extended Look.

name: Ambrosia
subtitle: Sugar town
summary: A small inland town built around a sugar refinery, with an old-Florida feel a long way from Vice City's glamour.

facts.text: A rural town centred on the Ambrosia Sugar refinery.

name: Mount Kalaga National Park
subtitle: Wilderness
summary: Forested hills and backcountry for hiking, camping and getting into trouble far from the city.

facts.text: A national park of wooded hills — Rockstar's site pitches it as Leonida's wilder side.

name: Port Gellhorn
subtitle: Gulf-coast beach town
summary: A once-popular beach town on the Gulf side that has slid into motels, biker bars and trailer parks.

facts.text: A faded seaside town with a biker scene, described by Rockstar as past its prime.
